preconditions.description: The number of operations n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t_i <= 3 for t_i in operations)
preconditions.description: Each operation type t_i is either 1, 2, or 3.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= len(sequence) for t_i, a_i, x_i in operations if t_i == 1)
preconditions.description: For operation type 1, a_i is between 1 and the current length of the sequence inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**3 <= x_i <= 10**3 for t_i, a_i, x_i in operations if t_i == 1)
preconditions.description: For operation type 1, x_i is between -1000 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**3 <= k_i <= 10**3 for t_i, k_i in operations if t_i == 2)
preconditions.description: For operation type 2, k_i is between -1000 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(sequence) >= 2 for t_i in operations if t_i == 3)
preconditions.description: For operation type 3, the sequence has at least 2 elements.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(avg, float) for avg in averages)
postconditions.description: Each average in the output is a float.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= avg <= 2 * 10**3 for avg in averages)
postconditions.description: Each average in the output is between 0 and 2000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(avg - sum(sequence) / len(sequence)) <= 10**-6 for avg, sequence in zip(averages, sequences))
postconditions.description: Each average is the correct average of the sequence after the corresponding operation, with an error tolerance of 10^-6.
